2023 
Author: Ajay Bhanot
Bench: Ajay Bhanot
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7287 of 2023
Applicant :- Vijendra Kumar Alias Guddu
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Siddhartha Baghel,Prateek Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.180 of 2022 at Police Station Chopan, District-Sonebhadra under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468,
471, 409 and 120-B I.P.C.
The applicant is in jail since 11.01.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 01.02.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Siddhartha Baghel, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned A.G.A.-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1). The applicant did not fabricate the receipts on the foot of which the vehicles were released from the police station.

Vijendra Kumar Alias Guddu vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113547724/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (2). The police station officials carry out due diligence regarding the authenticity of the receipts before releasing the vehicles.
(3). The vehicles have not been recovered from the possession of the applicant.
(4). The applicant has been scapegoated to deflect attention from the concerned police officials who were responsible for fraudulent release of the vehicles.
(5). The applicant has explained his criminal history.
Learned AGA contends that the applicant has a criminal history of some more cases.
Rejoining this issue, learned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is in jail.
He is financially destitute and does not have an effective pairokar.
Hence details of the cases could not be obtained and stated in the bail application.

However, relying on the records available with the learned AGA and the instructions received from his client, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant belongs to the economically weaker strata of the society and is a soft target for the police authorities.
The applicant has been falsely nominated in a number of cases only to show the proficiency of the police investigators.
The said cases do not have any bearing on the instant case.
(6). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Vijendra Kumar @ Guddu be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number,
on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Dhananjai  Vijendra Kumar Alias Guddu vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113547724/
